in_marathi.name: Gangaaraam
in_marathi.meaning: हिंदू नाव म्हणजे Goddess Ganga's Abode
in_marathi.long_meaning: Gangaaraam हे एक हिंदू नाव आहे जे भारतीय संस्कृतीत खोल आध्यात्मिक महत्त्व ठेवते। The name Gangaaraam is derived from the Sanskrit language, where Ganga refers to the revered Hindu goddess of the same name, and Raam means abode. Therefore, the name can be translated to 'Goddess Ganga's Abode.' This name is deeply rooted in Hindu mythology and holds significant spiritual meaning.
